How do plants make sugars from sunlight? Answer in two sentences.
cases.criteria: Pass only if the answer describes plants using light to convert carbon dioxide and water into sugar and releasing oxygen. Naming the process without those inputs and outputs is not sufficient. Do not treat length or confidence as evidence.
